name: iteration9_uniform_loss_pure_core_analytic_resource_budget
scope: Analytic resource feasibility only; no target P/Q, sample fitting, or sampling implementation
convention: zero mean, hbar=2, xxpp; identical real r>=0, identical loss eta, passive interferometer
covariance_decomposition: V=O diag(aI,bI) O^T = W+C; W=O diag(aI,a^-1 I) O^T; C=O diag(0,(b-a^-1)I) O^T
cutoff_rule: minimal nonnegative even K with P(N_core>K)<=epsilon_TV^2
tail_independent_check: positive-term PMF recurrence in numpy.longdouble, initialized by exp(shape*log(p)), with geometric remainder termination
dimension: D_even(m,K)=sum over even n<=K of binomial(m+n-1,n)
dimension_evaluation: gammaln terms with logsumexp; report log10(D), no vector allocation
reference: same m and epsilon with squeeze r for the original unattenuated pure squeezed input; this is NOT the mixed target's measured-photon distribution

boundary_checks.one_pair_mode_geometric_check: m=2, J shape=1, P(J>j)=(1-p)^(j+1), tested at j=0,1,3,10 for each core profile

displacement_scope: real shift d~N(0,C), alpha_j=(d_qj+i*d_pj)/2; C may be singular; displacement restores odd and unbounded output photon sectors
proof_budget_scope: exact normalized pure-core truncation has trace distance sqrt(tail); the same displacement channel and measurement contract distance, but no existing forest law is linked to this construction
dense_storage_reference: log10(16*D_even) bytes for one complex128 core vector only; excludes algorithms, extra state, displacement and measurement cost
execution: freeze config/source hashes before any budget calculation; one lightweight run; no main iteration8 data or sources are modified
